title.narrative: NIHR Group on POsT Conflict Trauma (PrOTeCT) Trauma in Sri Lanka

description.narrative: The NIHR Global Health Research Group on Post Conflict Trauma; PrOTeCT, was a collaborative grant between Imperial College London (UK), the University of Moratuwa (Sri Lanka) and the American University of Beirut (Lebanon). It brought together expertise in trauma practice, engineering and clinical research. The clinical goal for this NIHR Group was limb salvage for victims of conflict trauma. Within the lifetime of the grant, and beyond, we aimed to deliver measurable benefits to people in LMIC countries who have suffered injuries as a result of conflicts. We wanted to identify the types of injuries that have led to early amputation and those which are amendable to salvage. In addition, we aimed to develop and to clinically deploy technology for limb salvage and limb regeneration that will be appropriate wherever blast injuries occur.

The PrOTeCT Group successful designed an external fixator for use after traumatic injury, progressed regenerative medicine scaffolds towards future use in limb salvage and gained insights into the clinical burden of war injuries.
